settings.title: Settings
settings.note: Colour convention: price moves always read red for up, green for down (the mainland China convention); chain direction uses navy for upstream / bronze for downstream; gold is decoration only (rules, chips, watchlist) and never carries data. The three vocabularies never overlap.
home.title: ChainAtlas
home.sub: A knowledge graph of the A-share industry chain. Listed companies, laid out by SW level-1 sector. Open a sector to see its chain links and every company in it. Quotes and financials are real public data; industry and chain-link memberships are public classifications; upstream/downstream edges are inferred simulations.
home.note: Quotes and financials are real public data (East Money / akshare). SW level-1 industries and chain-link memberships are real public classifications. Upstream/downstream edges are model-inferred simulations and unverified — sharing a chain link is not a supplier relationship. Not investment advice.

wm.tilesNote2: One pie per sector: each slice is a chain link, sized by how many of the sector’s companies sit on it. Click a pie to open that sector’s full ring — company names live there.
ring.note: Dot size = market cap · colour = change (red up / green down, Chinese convention) · each outer arc is one chain link: the bigger links get their name printed horizontally outside the ring with a thin leader line back to the arc (names are never set along a radius — that reads upside-down on the left half). 124 links will not all fit, so hover an arc for a small label or use the full list below. Hover a dot to show the company and its link in the centre and draw its links to other links.
